description: This file defines an abstract base class for menu link plugins in Drupal, including methods for retrieving link properties, routes, options, and cache settings.

classes.name: MenuLinkBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for menu link plugins in Drupal.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the menu link, defaulting to 0 if not set.

methods.name: getMenuName
methods.description: Returns the menu name associated with the link.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the provider of the menu link.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent link or menu item.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the link is enabled.

methods.name: isExpanded
methods.description: Checks if the link is expanded.

methods.name: isResettable
methods.description: Indicates if the link can be reset (returns false).

methods.name: isTranslatable
methods.description: Checks if the link is translatable.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Checks if the link is deletable.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the options array for the link.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the link.

methods.name: getRouteName
methods.description: Returns the route name for the link.

methods.name: getRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns route parameters.

methods.name: getUrlObject
methods.description: Constructs and returns a URL object for the link.

methods.name: getFormClass
methods.description: Returns the form class associated with the link.

methods.name: getDeleteRoute
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no delete route by default.

methods.name: getEditRoute
methods.description: Returns the URL for editing the link.

methods.name: getResetRoute
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no reset route by default.

methods.name: getTranslateRoute
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no translate route.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns available operations (edit, reset, delete, translate) for the link.

methods.name: deleteLink
methods.description: Throws exception if deletion is attempted, as not supported.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age, set to permanent.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts (empty array).

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags (empty array).
